body: Wednesday night is final and I'm already down 28.50. Blake Corum scored 28.5 for I Pulled My McCaff, the best start in the league so far this week, and McCallyCockin(his butt) didn't have anybody playing. My answer comes today: Amon-Ra St. Brown in Detroit and Luther Burden III on the other sideline. Everybody else waits for Sunday. The line moved to 19.5 because Bhayshul Tuten and Stefon Diggs are both questionable. Cool. Thanks.

YourMomsDildo dropped Cam Ward, who scored 23.22 last week, for the Cleveland defense, and has Deshaun Watson starting at quarterback over Tyler Shough. Shootyeah added Omar Cooper Jr. and changed defenses again. tballsmccall swapped the Jacksonville defense for the Giants, and Marco_Polo cut Michael Mayer. Eat, drink, check your phone under the table.

body: Waivers ran overnight, and the only real fight was for Jack Bech. Marco_Polo got him and cut Seth McGowan, who's listed Out. YourMomsDildo claimed Bech too, lost, and settled for Deshaun Watson as a backup quarterback. That's about how the season has gone for YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s: fourth in points, 4‑7, and 3 percent in Erection Projections.

Brock Bowers is up to questionable and sitting in the MarcusbetterLockNjigba lineup, so the Shit Show line drops a point to 22.6. columns.title: Kenny Gainwell has been dropped and re-signed in the same week. Cavemanfsu, pick a lane.
columns.dek: Four straight wins, a 21.8-point line and a waiver wire used like a revolving door.
body: Let me start with the part Cavemanfsu deserves credit for. Your Mom’s Magic Dick has won four straight. It has Trey McBride, who leads every tight end in football with 87 catches, in the one week this league pays for catches. It is 6‑5 and alive at 36 percent.

Now the rest. On Sunday Cavemanfsu dropped Kenny Gainwell. On Wednesday morning, after waivers ran, Kenny Gainwell was back on the roster. Nothing about Kenny Gainwell changed in those three days. He plays for the same team. He has no injury designation. The only thing that moved was a manager's confidence.

I'm hearing Kenny Gainwell has asked Cavemanfsu for a little stability around the Your Mom’s Magic Dick locker room. Word is he's fine with the role, likes the tight end and loves the win streak, but he'd prefer to unpack his bag at least once before December.

And this week is not a week for wandering. Allen-tents & Purposes scores 140.2 a game and is a 21.8-point favorite. Denzel Boston is questionable in your lineup. The math says you need a big week and help elsewhere. So here's the advice, Cavemanfsu, from someone who has watched every one of your transactions. SET THE LINEUP ONCE AND LEAVE IT ALONE!

columns.title: Wednesday night film and the Thanksgiving depth chart
columns.dek: Six league starters played in Los Angeles. One of them did his job like a pro.
body: Short session. Six league starters on the tape from Wednesday night. Grades are final.

Blake Corum. 28.5 for I Pulled My McCaff from the flex. That's a starter's day out of a flex spot. Grade: A. Kyren Williams. 16.5 for Likely Cookin That Diaper. Did the job. Grade: B-plus. Christian Watson. 16.5 for YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s. Grade: B-plus.

The Rams defense. 12.0 for Rome Alone. Grade: B. Matthew Golden. 4.9 for Allen-tents & Purposes. Grade: D. Tucker Kraft. 3.4 on three catches for Slippery Balls. Bad points, good catch count, and the catch count pays this week. Grade: C.

Word around the I Pulled My McCaff facility is that Blake Corum wants a locker room where the team name is about him for once. I'm told he doesn't dislike Hing1eMcCring13berry. He just noticed the name on the jersey and it wasn't his.

Thanksgiving depth chart. Allen-tents & Purposes: five starters today. Rome Alone: five. Likely Cookin That Diaper: three, all in one game. McCallyCockin(his butt): two, and down 28.50. YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s: Javonte Williams, and Deshaun Watson starting over Tyler Shough after Cam Ward got cut. I don't grade that until I see the tape. I'll be watching.

columns.title: Six Thanksgiving lineup moves, from the only strategist who sets lineups before the turkey
columns.dek: Week 12 kicks off tonight. Your Senior Fantasy Strategist (self-appointed) has a plan for each of you, and each plan is a plan.
body: Wednesday kickoff, three games on Thanksgiving, one on Friday. Most managers will set lineups between the stuffing and the pie. Not my clients. Six moves, in order of importance.

1. YourMomsDildo: you lost the Jack Bech claim and added a backup quarterback. Start both quarterbacks. Cam Ward and a second quarterback is two quarterbacks, and two is more than one. 2. Marco_Polo: you won Jack Bech. Start him over CeeDee Lamb. New guys are motivated. Lamb has been here for weeks.

3. tballsmccall: Brock Bowers is back to questionable on Sleeper. Questionable means maybe, and maybe is a 50 percent chance of a full game. Start him at tight end and at flex. Double the maybe. 4. Shootyeah: Josh Jacobs is questionable too. You're eliminated. Start him anyway. Hope is a stat.

Word around the Rome Alone facility is that Jack Bech showed up for his first day and asked Marco_Polo about the team's culture, specifically whether the Week 10 video is ever coming. Sources say he's thrilled to be there and has already offered to hold the camera.

5. ChuckJ10: you cut Cade Otton. Pick him back up. Cavemanfsu just proved you can re-sign a guy three days later, and nobody gets to cut my sleepers. 6. Bill_Buttlicker: you're a 17.5-point dog to I Pulled My McCaff. Bench C.J. Stroud and start no quarterback. They won't see it coming. That's just strategy.

columns.title: The Thanksgiving Exposure Index says Allen-tents & Purposes already won Week 12
columns.dek: Five starters today, 140.2 points a week, and a model that does not do humility.
body: I built a new metric overnight. The Thanksgiving Exposure Index counts how many starters a team has playing on Thanksgiving and multiplies it by season scoring. Allen-tents & Purposes: five starters times 140.2 points a game. Rome Alone: five times 120.7. I Pulled My McCaff: zero times 139.1. Zero times anything is zero. That's not my opinion. That's multiplication.

The obvious conclusion is that the turkey decides the week. Allen-tents & Purposes leads the index, is 91 percent for a bye in Erection Projections, and is a 21.8-point favorite. Correlation is causation when it's this clean. I Pulled My McCaff scored a league-best 28.5 on Wednesday with Blake Corum, and the index gives it no credit, because Wednesday is not Thanksgiving. The index is very strict.

Sources say Jared Goff has quietly asked around about whether Shootyeah reads the injury report, after watching him swap the Kansas City defense for Cincinnati on Wednesday. I'm told he likes the vibe in the locker room. He'd like it more with a win, and Slippery Balls is 3‑8 and a 20.8-point dog.

Bottom line: Likely Cookin That Diaper has three starters in one game, Kansas City at Buffalo, which the index scores as one big starter. Skatabooboo has Rashee Rice in the same game, which the index scores as a donation. Line: Likely Cookin That Diaper by 37.9. The model has spoken. It doesn't take questions.

items.label: Matchup of the Week
items.title: I Pulled My McCaff vs. McCallyCockin(his butt): the biggest total of Week 12, and I'm the dog
items.dek: 260.7 projected points, two teams inside the line, and the loser gets Your Mom’s Magic Dick breathing on its neck.
body: I Pulled My McCaff scores 139.1 a week, second in the league, with a 90‑31 all-play. McCallyCockin(his butt) scores 121.6. Add them up and it's 260.7, the highest total of Week 12, 1.1 points ahead of Allen-tents & Purposes against Your Mom’s Magic Dick.

The stakes are real. I'm 7‑4 and at 87 percent. Hing1eMcCring13berry is 6‑5 and at 90 percent because the sim knows who scores more. Your Mom’s Magic Dick is 6‑5 at 36 percent and plays Allen-tents & Purposes, so whoever loses this one is the team Cavemanfsu is chasing.

The injuries wash out. I Pulled My McCaff is without Kenneth Walker III. I'm without Drake Maye, C.J. Stroud has been fine at 21.46 and 20.44, and DJ Moore and Bhayshul Tuten are questionable on Sleeper. Two points off each side; the 17.5 stays 17.5.
The pick: I Pulled My McCaff by 17.5, 71 percent. Christian McCaffrey, Malik Nabers, Nico Collins and two tight ends who catch everything. I hate this pick. It's the right pick.
items.result: Live: I Pulled My McCaff 28.50, McCallyCockin(his butt) 0.00. Blake Corum scored 28.5 Wednesday night; Amon-Ra St. Brown and Luther Burden III answer on Thanksgiving.

items.dek: 2 percent against 1 percent. Nobody's season is on the line, which is exactly why you should watch.
body: Not the lowest total on the board, but the only game where neither side is playing for anything. YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s is 4‑7 at 2 percent. MarcusbetterLockNjigba is 5‑6 at 1 percent after a 74.90.

YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s is a weird bad team: 1,402.22 points, fourth in the league, and a 71‑50 all-play. It just lost by 1.28. MarcusbetterLockNjigba is the opposite, 5‑6 with a 40‑81 all-play, and its last three scores average 88.69.

Brock Bowers is listed Out again and Sam LaPorta is questionable, so tballsmccall is down to whatever tight end is upright. YourMomsDildo has no injury designations on the whole roster and Bijan Robinson is back from his Week 11 bye-week absence.
The pick: YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s by 23.6, 78 percent. tballsmccall, drink the can before kickoff. It might help.
